verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent-behavior benchmark includes a "reply-to-thread" task graded on "where the reply lands," and the README refers to agents posting "the threads." Together these imply threaded replies exist, but only indirectly and only through agent behavior. missing for 10: first-party docs describing human or team-admin thread replies, any description of how threads stay attached to the parent message in the UI or CLI, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: what is graded is how the agent answers it through Buzz — where the reply lands, who it notifies
Agents search six months of history and post the threads, not vibes.
